metadata.title: Boltzmann Constant (Exact 2019 SI Definition & Statistical Entropy)

metadata.summary: Exact 2019 SI value k_B = 1.380649 x 10^-23 J/K bridging macroscopic temperature T, microscopic thermal energy, and Boltzmann entropy S = k_B ln Omega.

metadata.teacher_model: Golden-Slice v4.0 Closed-Form RRR + Cutting-Plane Rosetta (Zero-SGD)
metadata.teacher_reference: The Boltzmann constant ($k_B$) is equal to $k_B = 1.380649 \times 10^{-23}\text{ J/K}$ (joules per kelvin), linking temperature $T$ to thermal energy and statistical entropy $S = k_B \ln \Omega$.

metadata.title: Landauer's Principle (Thermodynamic Cost of Irreversible Bit Erasure)
metadata.title_pt: Princípio de Landauer (Limite Termodinâmico de Apagamento de 1 Bit)
metadata.summary: Irreversibly erasing 1 bit of information in a thermal bath at temperature T dissipates at least E_min = k_B T ln 2 of heat.
metadata.example_prompt: Me fale sobre o princípio de Landauer na física da informação.

prompts_polyglot.pt: Me fale sobre o princípio de Landauer na física da informação.
prompts_polyglot.en: Explain Landauer's principle in the physics of information.
prompts_polyglot.es: Explícame el principio de Landauer en la física de la información.
prompts_polyglot.fr: Expliquez le principe de Landauer en physique de l'information.

metadata.teacher_model: Golden-Slice v4.0 Closed-Form RRR + Cutting-Plane Rosetta (Zero-SGD)
metadata.teacher_reference: Landauer's principle ($E_{\min} = k_B T \ln 2$) states that irreversibly erasing 1 bit of information at absolute temperature $T$ dissipates at least $k_B T \ln 2$ of heat ($\Delta S \ge k_B \ln 2$).

metadata.title: Immerman-Szelepcsényi Theorem (NSPACE = co-NSPACE Inductive Counting)
metadata.title_pt: Teorema de Immerman-Szelepcsényi (NSPACE = co-NSPACE por Contagem Indutiva)
metadata.summary: Every nondeterministic space class s(n) >= log n is closed under complementation (NL = coNL) via inductive counting of reachable configurations.
metadata.example_prompt: O que prova o teorema de Immerman-Szelepcsényi sobre classes de espaço não-determinístico?

prompts_polyglot.pt: O que prova o teorema de Immerman-Szelepcsényi sobre classes de espaço não-determinístico?
prompts_polyglot.en: What does the Immerman-Szelepcsényi theorem prove about nondeterministic space classes?
prompts_polyglot.es: ¿Qué demuestra el teorema de Immerman-Szelepcsényi sobre la complejidad espacial no determinista?
prompts_polyglot.fr: Que démontre le théorème d'Immerman-Szelepcsényi sur les classes d'espace non déterministe ?

metadata.teacher_model: Golden-Slice v4.0 Closed-Form RRR + Cutting-Plane Rosetta (Zero-SGD)
metadata.teacher_reference: The Immerman-Szelepcsényi theorem (1987) proves $\text{NSPACE}(s(n)) = \text{co-NSPACE}(s(n))$ for $s(n) \ge \log n$ (hence $\text{NL} = \text{coNL}$) by inductively counting exact reachable configurations $C_d$ in $O(s(n))$ space.

metadata.title: FLP Impossibility Theorem (Asynchronous Crash-Fault Consensus)
metadata.title_pt: Teorema da Impossibilidade FLP (Consenso Assíncrono com Falha por Parada)
metadata.summary: Fischer-Lynch-Paterson (1985) proves no deterministic consensus protocol in an asynchronous network can guarantee termination, agreement, and validity under even 1 unannounced process crash.

prompts_polyglot.fr: Expliquez le théorème d'impossibilité de Fischer-Lynch-Paterson dans les systèmes distribués.

metadata.teacher_model: Golden-Slice v4.0 Closed-Form RRR + Cutting-Plane Rosetta (Zero-SGD)
metadata.teacher_reference: The Fischer-Lynch-Paterson (FLP, 1985) theorem proves that in a purely asynchronous network, no deterministic consensus protocol guarantees termination, agreement, and validity if even 1 process may crash unannounced.

metadata.title: Marchenko-Pastur Spectral Law (Random Sample Covariance Eigenvalues)
metadata.title_pt: Lei Espectral de Marchenko-Pastur (Autovalores de Covariância Aleatória)
metadata.summary: Limiting eigenvalue support [lambda_-, lambda_+] with lambda_pm = sigma^2 (1 +- sqrt(gamma))^2 for p x n random matrices as p/n -> gamma.
metadata.example_prompt: O que estabelece a lei espectral de Marchenko-Pastur para matrizes aleatórias de covariância?

prompts_polyglot.pt: O que estabelece a lei espectral de Marchenko-Pastur para matrizes aleatórias de covariância?
prompts_polyglot.en: What does the Marchenko-Pastur spectral law state for random sample covariance matrices?
prompts_polyglot.es: ¿Qué establece la ley espectral de Marchenko-Pastur para matrices aleatorias de covarianza?
prompts_polyglot.fr: Qu'établit la loi spectrale de Marchenko-Pastur pour les matrices de covariance aléatoires ?

metadata.teacher_model: Golden-Slice v4.0 Closed-Form RRR + Cutting-Plane Rosetta (Zero-SGD)
metadata.teacher_reference: The Marchenko-Pastur law (1967) shows that for $p \times n$ i.i.d. entries of variance $\sigma^2$ with $p/n \to \gamma$, sample covariance eigenvalues concentrate on $[\lambda_-, \lambda_+]$ where $\lambda_{\pm} = \sigma^2(1 \pm \sqrt{\gamma})^2$.

metadata.title: Kabatiansky-Levenshtein Bound (High-Dimensional Sphere Packing 0.5990)
metadata.title_pt: Limite de Kabatiansky-Levenshtein (Empacotamento Esférico 0.5990)
metadata.summary: Best known asymptotic upper bound 2^{-0.5990 n (1 + o(1))} on Euclidean sphere-packing density in R^n via Gegenbauer polynomials.
metadata.example_prompt: Qual limite superior assintótico o teorema de Kabatiansky-Levenshtein estabelece para empacotamento de esferas?

prompts_polyglot.pt: Qual limite superior assintótico o teorema de Kabatiansky-Levenshtein estabelece para empacotamento de esferas?
prompts_polyglot.en: What asymptotic upper bound does the Kabatiansky-Levenshtein theorem establish for sphere packing?
prompts_polyglot.es: ¿Qué cota superior asintótica establece el teorema de Kabatiansky-Levenshtein para el empaquetamiento de esferas?
prompts_polyglot.fr: Quelle borne supérieure asymptotique le théorème de Kabatiansky-Levenshtein établit-il pour l'empilement de sphères ?

metadata.teacher_model: Golden-Slice v4.0 Closed-Form RRR + Cutting-Plane Rosetta (Zero-SGD)
metadata.teacher_reference: The Kabatiansky-Levenshtein bound (1978) proves via Gegenbauer linear programming on spherical codes that Euclidean sphere-packing density in $\mathbb{R}^n$ satisfies $\Delta_n \le 2^{-0.5990\,n(1 + o(1))}$.

metadata.title: Chaitin's Algorithmic Incompleteness (Kolmogorov Complexity K(x) > L & Omega)
metadata.title_pt: Incompletude Algorítmica de Chaitin (Complexidade de Kolmogorov K(x) > L e Ômega)
metadata.summary: Any sound formal axiom system F cannot prove K(x) > L for strings beyond L_F = K(F) + c bits, epitomized by Chaitin's halting probability Omega.
metadata.example_prompt: O que afirma o teorema da incompletude algorítmica de Chaitin sobre a complexidade de Kolmogorov?

prompts_polyglot.pt: O que afirma o teorema da incompletude algorítmica de Chaitin sobre a complexidade de Kolmogorov?
prompts_polyglot.en: What does Chaitin's algorithmic incompleteness theorem state about Kolmogorov complexity?
prompts_polyglot.es: ¿Qué afirma el teorema de incompletitud algorítmica de Chaitin sobre la complejidad de Kolmogorov?
prompts_polyglot.fr: Qu'affirme le théorème d'incomplétude algorithmique de Chaitin sur la complexité de Kolmogorov ?

metadata.teacher_model: Golden-Slice v4.0 Closed-Form RRR + Cutting-Plane Rosetta (Zero-SGD)
metadata.teacher_reference: Chaitin's incompleteness theorem proves that any sound formal system $F$ has a constant $L_F = K(F) + c$ above which it cannot prove $K(x) > L_F$ for any string $x$, reflected in Chaitin's halting probability $\Omega$.

metadata.title: Regev's LWE Reduction (Worst-Case GapSVP / SIVP Post-Quantum Hardness)
metadata.title_pt: Redução LWE de Regev (Segurança Pós-Quântica de Pior Caso GapSVP / SIVP)
metadata.summary: Regev (2005) proves average-case Learning With Errors (LWE) is at least as hard as worst-case lattice problems GapSVP and SIVP under quantum reductions.
metadata.example_prompt: Qual redução de dificuldade de pior caso em reticulados fundamenta o problema LWE de Regev?

prompts_polyglot.pt: Qual redução de dificuldade de pior caso em reticulados fundamenta o problema LWE de Regev?

prompts_polyglot.fr: Quelle réduction de difficulté dans le pire cas sur les réseaux fonde le problème LWE de Regev ?

metadata.teacher_model: Golden-Slice v4.0 Closed-Form RRR + Cutting-Plane Rosetta (Zero-SGD)
metadata.teacher_reference: Regev's theorem (2005) establishes a quantum reduction showing that solving average-case Learning With Errors ($\text{LWE}_{n,q,\chi}$) is at least as hard as approximating worst-case lattice problems $\text{GapSVP}_\gamma$ and $\text{SIVP}_\gamma$.

metadata.title: Shannon-Hartley Capacity & Ultimate -1.59 dB Eb/N0 Limit
metadata.title_pt: Capacidade de Shannon-Hartley e Limite Fundamental de -1,59 dB Eb/N0
metadata.summary: AWGN channel capacity C = B log_2(1 + S/N) bits/s and ultimate infinite-bandwidth energy-per-bit limit Eb/N0 = ln 2 (-1.59 dB).
metadata.example_prompt: Enuncie o teorema da capacidade de canal de Shannon-Hartley e o limite fundamental de Eb/N0.

prompts_polyglot.pt: Enuncie o teorema da capacidade de canal de Shannon-Hartley e o limite fundamental de Eb/N0.
prompts_polyglot.en: State the Shannon-Hartley channel capacity theorem and its fundamental Eb/N0 limit.
prompts_polyglot.es: Enuncia el teorema de capacidad de canal de Shannon-Hartley y su límite fundamental de Eb/N0.
prompts_polyglot.fr: Énoncez le théorème de capacité de canal de Shannon-Hartley et sa limite fondamentale Eb/N0.

metadata.teacher_model: Golden-Slice v4.0 Closed-Form RRR + Cutting-Plane Rosetta (Zero-SGD)
metadata.teacher_reference: The Shannon-Hartley theorem gives AWGN channel capacity $C = B \log_2(1 + S/N)\text{ bits/s}$, yielding as $B \to \infty$ the ultimate Shannon limit $E_b/N_0 \ge \ln 2 \approx 0.693$ ($-1.59\text{ dB}$).

metadata.title: Sleep-Consolidated Bridge: Landauer Thermodynamics x Immerman-Szelepcsényi Space
metadata.title_pt: Ponte Consolidada (Sleep): Termodinâmica de Landauer x Espaço de Immerman-Szelepcsényi
metadata.summary: Conjunctive bridge (fires ONLY when both Landauer and Immerman-Szelepcsényi co-activate) reconciling O(log n) inductive counter overwrites with k_B T ln 2 via Bennett reversible pebbling.

prompts_polyglot.es: ¿Cómo interactúa la reutilización de espacio del conteo inductivo de Immerman-Szelepcsényi con el principio termodinámico de Landauer?
prompts_polyglot.fr: Comment la réutilisation d'espace du comptage inductif d'Immerman-Szelepcsényi interagit-elle avec le principe thermodynamique de Landauer ?

metadata.teacher_model: Golden-Slice v4.0 Conjunctive Sleep Consolidation (Zero-SGD)
metadata.teacher_reference: By Bennett's reversible pebbling, Immerman-Szelepcsényi $O(\log n)$ counter overwrites avoid Landauer's $k_B T \ln 2$ heat dissipation per erased bit
